label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering with refreshments and a private presentation tomorrow at eighteen in the great hall, likely a surprise marking my forty years as mayor. The innkeeper is arranging an escort and insists on no early arrival; freight deposited bread in a hall chest. The secretary knowingly helps schedule and arrange the escort. The gathering itself has been disclosed, but presentation details remain deliberately private; the anniversary purpose is a suspicion, not confirmed.
